mainEntity.name: How much does AI SEO for local businesses cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of AI SEO services for local businesses varies depending on several factors, including the scope of services, the competitiveness of your local market, and the size of your business. Basic packages might focus on Google My Business optimization and local keyword targeting, while more comprehensive plans could include content creation, link building, and advanced data analytics. Most providers offer customized proposals after an initial consultation to accurately assess your specific needs and provide a transparent pricing structure.
